note: Scope reduced to BajajLife-approved games only. Games dropped by feedback (Compound Quest, Shield Spin) and all concepts without explicit BajajLife sign-off were removed from the repository. The former gold standard life-goals-bubble-shooter was removed; its patterns are captured in okf-brain/GAME_STANDARD.md and mirrored in the surviving games.

newGames.concept: Cover / Shield Placement Physics (Cover Orange style)
newGames.brief: Physics puzzle: family member characters sit on a level layout. Player drags & drops shield objects (umbrellas, crates, barrels rendered as glossy vector shapes) from a tray onto the scene. After placement (or a GO button / 3s timer), a virus storm sweeps across the top raining spiky virus particles that fall with gravity and bounce. Any family member touched by a virus is lost. Protect all members to win the round. 6 hand-designed rounds of rising complexity inside a 2-minute session, score = members saved x100 + unused shields x50 + time bonus. Simple 2D physics: gravity, AABB/circle collisions, stacking. Viruses are green spiky orbs with glow, NOT emoji.

newGames.financialConcept: Bridging coverage gaps in life journey
newGames.feedback: Ok, Dont use stages just keep one stage with longer process but time limit should be 2min max
newGames.brief: Bloxorz clone: a 1x1x2 block rolls (swipe or on-screen arrows) across an isometric-looking tile board floating over a void. Falling off or overhanging the edge = fall & respawn at start (small time penalty). Board tiles labelled as life stages (First Job, Marriage, Home, Child, Retirement checkpoints that light up when crossed). ONE long single stage (~30-45 moves optimal) with bridges/switch tiles that toggle when rolled over, and fragile tiles that break if the block stands vertically on them. 2-minute countdown; reach the goal hole (drop block vertically into it) to win. Score = time remaining x10 + checkpoints crossed x200. Render with crisp pseudo-3D: top+side faces with gradient shading, soft drop shadow, smooth 150ms roll tween per move.

newGames.concept: Forward-rail crowd shooter (Battle Brigade / Mob Control style)
newGames.financialConcept: Building a stable bridge for long-term wealth
newGames.feedback: Ok, Replace army with virus and powerup with health shield that increases the firing power
newGames.brief: Auto-forward rail shooter: player character (blue guardian with glowing shield emblem) auto-runs along a bridge over water, auto-firing energy bolts forward. Drag horizontally to steer between 3 lanes. Waves of green virus blobs (varied sizes, HP shown as small bars) march toward the player; bolts damage them; a virus reaching the player drains health. Collect floating HEALTH SHIELD pickups (hex shield with cross) - each one restores health AND permanently increases fire rate/damage this run (stacking power). 90-second run to reach the vault at bridge end = win. Score = viruses destroyed x10 + shields collected x100 + health remaining bonus. Parallax water & sky, muzzle flashes, hit particles, boss virus at the end.

newGames.feedback: Ok, Replace with Life goals: Shield, Savings, Home, Car, Education, Marriage, Child, Retirement, Health, Rewards, Family. Use better Assets for this not emoji
newGames.gameFeedback: Ok, But How to play must only have animation not text.
newGames.brief: Triple-match: a scattered pile of overlapping life-goal tokens (Shield, Savings coin, Home, Car, Education cap, Marriage rings, Child, Retirement chair, Health heart-pulse, Rewards gift, Family) rendered as premium layered inline-SVG icon sprites (gradient fills, inner highlights, soft shadows - absolutely no emoji). Tap a token to move it into a 7-slot tray at the bottom; 3 identical tokens in the tray auto-merge with a satisfying pop + particles. Tray full with no match = lose. Clear the whole board within 2 minutes = win. Tokens deeper in the pile are dimmed/locked until uncovered. ~60 tokens (20 triplets), gentle shuffle + 1 free undo + 1 magnet booster. Score = matches x100 + time bonus + tray-efficiency bonus. HOW-TO-PLAY MUST BE ANIMATION ONLY - no instructional text.

newGames.concept: Arrow sliding escape puzzle (Arrow Exit style)
newGames.brief: Unblock-style arrow puzzle: a 6x6 grid packed with rounded arrow blocks, each pointing up/down/left/right. Tap an arrow: it slides in its pointing direction until it exits the board (collect + score) or hits another block (bump animation + tiny shake). Clear all arrows to finish the level; wrong-order taps waste moves. Blocks styled as sleek gradient chevrons in brand palette; risk blocks (red, marked with virus icon) must be cleared last or they lock neighbors - teaching order-of-decisions. 5 escalating boards inside a 2-minute timer, move counter, combo bonus for consecutive successful exits. Score = exits x50 + remaining time x10 - bumps x10.

newGames.concept: Hang glider / canyon gliding (Canyon Glider style)
newGames.feedback: Reference not opening - rebuilt from concept description
newGames.brief: Glider physics: hold to dive (gain speed), release to convert speed into lift and soar. Side-scrolling canyon with parallax rock layers; canyon ceiling/floor undulate. Collect gold wealth coins and blue shield tokens along flight arcs; shields grant 1-hit protection against red risk spikes/birds (virus-styled hazards). Distance milestones labelled as life stages (Graduation 200m, First Job 500m, Marriage 900m, Home 1400m, Retirement 2000m) with banner popups. Run ends on unshielded collision or at 2000m (win) or 105s cap. Score = distance + coins x25 + stages reached x300. Smooth camera, wind trail particles behind glider, day-sky gradient.

newGames.feedback: Reference not opening - rebuilt from concept description
newGames.brief: Physics artillery puzzle: a fixed cannon at bottom-left; drag to aim (trajectory dots preview) and release to fire a glowing shield orb. Levels are structures of wooden planks/crates with green virus blobs perched on them. Shield orb + collapsing debris destroy viruses on contact; gravity + simple rigid-body tumble (rect bodies, rotation) makes structures cascade. Limited shots per level (3-5). 5 levels in a 2-minute session. Score = viruses cleared x150 + shots remaining x100 + demolition bonus. Squash-and-stretch on impacts, dust particles, slow-mo 0.3s on final virus of each level.

newGames.financialConcept: Bridging life's gaps - momentum of continuous protection
newGames.brief: Side-scrolling rope-swing traversal over a dusk canyon (parallax SVG backdrop layers). One-touch control: press-and-hold throws a rope to the nearest glowing shield anchor ahead and the guardian swings as a pendulum under gravity with light damping; release lets go, carrying the tangential speed into a projectile arc toward the next anchor. A generous auto-target radius, input buffering, and an assisted reach while falling keep near-misses connecting without steering input. Single 105-second run scrolling right toward the Retirement Vault at 2,000 m, with banner popups at Graduation 200m, First Job 500m, Marriage 900m, Home 1400m. Green virus orbs drift in the gaps (an unshielded touch knocks the guardian off the rope); blue shield tokens grant 1-hit protection; gold coins are laid along the ideal swing arcs, rewarding good release timing. Anchor spacing widens and virus density rises as the run progresses. Win: reach the vault. Lose: fall past the canyon floor, or the session timer expires. Score = coins x25 + milestones x300 + Perfect Release x50 (releasing on the forward low arc). Rope renders as a tapered curve with sag and a snap-taut animation on grab; synth audio for grab/release/coin/shield/win; no emoji sprites.

newGames.financialConcept: Navigating life's risks to reach each life milestone
newGames.brief: Portrait top-down lane-hopper rendered as flat-shaded pseudo-3D rows (top + front face gradients, soft drop shadows, no emoji sprites) on a fixed 48-row course from Start to Retirement, 7 columns wide. Tap hops forward one row; swipe left/right/down hops sideways or back; each hop is a ~120ms tween with a small arc, squash-and-stretch landing, and dust particles. Safe pavement rows carry occasional planter obstacles; risk roads stream green virus blobs across at lane-specific speeds and directions (unshielded contact ends the run, a shield token saves once); uncertainty rivers introduced after the Marriage milestone are crossable only by hopping onto drifting glowing coverage platforms. Six milestone rows (Graduation 8, First Job 16, Marriage 24, Home 32, Child 40, Retirement 48) are full-width safe bands with a banner popup and fanfare on first touch. A rising risk-tide fog from below punishes standing still, keeping the session moving alongside the 2-minute cap. Win: reach the Retirement row within the session. Lose: unshielded virus hit, river/fog, the tide, or timeout. Score = furthest row x10 + coins x25 + milestones x300 + time bonus on win (5 per second remaining).

newGames.financialConcept: Asset allocation - fitting every asset class into a balanced portfolio
newGames.brief: 1010!-style: 9x9 board; three asset pieces offered at a time (tetromino-like shapes themed as asset classes: Equity=orange, Debt=blue, Gold=gold, Insurance=green with shield sheen). Drag pieces onto the board; completing a full row or column clears it with a sweep animation + particles ('Portfolio Rebalanced!'). No gravity, no rotation. Game ends when no offered piece fits (lose) or the 2-minute timer ends (score win). Clearing rows containing all 4 asset colors = Diversification Bonus x2. Score = cells placed + clears x100 + diversification bonuses. Ghost preview while dragging, invalid-drop shake, streak flames on multi-clears. Restored from archive commit 1cf30a9 after sign-off.

newGames.financialConcept: Riding market cycles - descend through volatility, avoid the crash zones
newGames.brief: Helix jump: a bouncing shield ball descends a rotating spiral tower; drag horizontally to rotate the tower (pseudo-3D platform arcs as ellipse segments with depth shading). Each ring has gaps (fall through to descend), safe blue arcs, and red crash arcs (touch = lose unless in fever). Passing 3+ rings in one fall = fever streak (ball flames, smashes through one red arc). 40 rings to the vault at the bottom = win; 2-minute cap. Rings labelled with descending years-to-retirement every 10 rings. Score = rings descended x20 + fever smashes x100 + finish bonus. Bounce squash, paint-splash on landing, tower gradient darkens with depth.

newGames.financialConcept: Market volatility & ULIP - disciplined investing through ups and downs
newGames.brief: Plinko: tap/drag to choose drop position at top, release a gold premium coin that bounces down through rows of glowing pegs (circle physics, restitution, slight randomness) into buckets at the bottom labelled with goal multipliers (Retirement x5, Home x3, Education x2, Savings x1, and 2 red Risk x0 buckets that flash). 10 coins per session (or 90s cap). Occasional blue shield peg: touching it shields the coin so a Risk bucket pays x1 instead of x0 - insurance smooths volatility. Running total with animated counter; combo streak for consecutive scoring buckets. Win = total payout above a tuned target. Peg hit sparkles, bucket win confetti bursts, coin trail.

newGames.financialConcept: One policy protects many - the ripple effect of family coverage
newGames.brief: Chain-reaction: 40-60 drifting orbs float on screen - most are blue family orbs, some green virus orbs that must NOT be caught. One tap per wave creates an expanding shield ripple; any family orb it touches becomes a new expanding ripple (chain), viruses touched shrink the ripple. Each wave has a protect target; 5 waves in 2 minutes with rising orb speed. Win = clear all 5 wave targets. Score = orbs protected x40 + chain-depth bonus + wave-clear x200. Translucent expanding rings, orb glow, slow-motion on mega-chain (15+), count-up ticker of protected members.

newGames.financialConcept: De-risking your portfolio without destabilizing your life plan
newGames.brief: Physics tower: a 12-layer tower of alternating blocks; some are RED RISK blocks (high-interest debt, junk investment, virus icon), others BLUE FOUNDATION blocks (term cover, emergency fund). Tap-and-flick red blocks to pull them out; tower center-of-mass + wobble physics reacts - pull the wrong support and the tower sways; topple = lose. Remove ALL red blocks to win; a stability meter shows center-of-mass offset with heartbeat when critical. 2-minute cap. Score = risks removed x200 + stability average bonus + time bonus. Dust particles, slow tilt when leaning, dramatic collapse on loss.

newGames.financialConcept: Staying on track - disciplined orbit around your life goals
newGames.brief: Orbit timing: a comet circles a glowing goal planet. Tap to release tangentially and get captured by the next planet's orbit (Education, Car, Marriage... distinct vector-art planets). Time releases for clean transfer arcs; drifting green virus asteroids or flying off-screen cost a life (3 lives). Coins dot the transfer paths; every 5th planet is a MILESTONE banner + bonus. Speed rises gradually; 20 planets or 2-minute cap = win/lose. Score = planets reached x100 + coins x20 + perfect-transfer (no orbit >1 loop) x50. Orbit trails, gravity-well glow rings, star parallax.

newGames.financialConcept: Knock out risks in one decisive shot - comprehensive cover
newGames.brief: Bowling: pseudo-3D lane (perspective trapezoid with gloss reflections); 10 pins styled as green virus bottles (front pins labelled Illness, Accident, Debt, Inflation). Flick the glowing shield ball - flick speed sets power, angle sets direction, small post-flick curve via swipe curl. Ball-pin and pin-pin 2D collisions on the lane plane projected to perspective. 5 frames, 2 throws each with strike/spare bonuses and a simplified scorecard; 2-minute cap. Win = total pins above a tuned target. Pin explosion into particle shards on strike + STRIKE banner, gutter wobble, ball trail, crowd-cheer synth swell.
